title: I used to ...
summary: **used to + глагол** — о том, что было регулярным или верным в прошлом, а теперь уже нет.
ru:
## Что значит used to
**used to** говорит о прошлой привычке или состоянии, которых **сейчас нет**. По-русски: «раньше я ...», «бывало, я ...».
> I **used to play** tennis. Now I play golf. — Раньше я играла в теннис. Теперь играю в гольф.
> Liz **used to have** long hair. — У Лиз раньше были длинные волосы (теперь короткие).
> They **used to live** in the same street as us. — Они раньше жили на нашей улице.

## Как образуется
> подлежащее + **used to** + глагол в начальной форме

Форма одинаковая для всех лиц: I / you / he / she / we / they **used to**.
> When I was a child, I **used to like** chocolate. — В детстве я любила шоколад.
> Ann **used to have** a piano. — У Анны раньше было пианино.

## Отрицание и вопрос
В них нужен **did**, а у used меняется на **use**.
> I **didn't use to like** tomatoes. — Я раньше не любила помидоры.
> **Did** you **use to live** here? — Ты раньше жила здесь?
> Where **did** you **use to live**? — Где ты жила раньше?

## Только прошлое
**used to** — всегда про прошлое. В настоящем такой формы нет, используйте обычный present simple.
- ~~I use to play golf.~~ → I **play** golf these days. / I **used to** play tennis.
- ~~We use to get up early.~~ → We **usually get up** early. (настоящее)

## Сравнение: used to и past simple
- **used to work** — раньше работал (много раз, долго, теперь нет): He **used to work** in a factory. Now he works in a supermarket.
- **worked** — просто факт в прошлом: He **worked** there in 2010.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I didn't used to like it.~~ → I didn't **use** to like it.
- ~~Did you used to play?~~ → Did you **use** to play?
- ~~I used to going there.~~ → I used to **go** there.
en:
## What does used to mean?
We use **used to** for things that were true or regular in the past, but are **not true now**.
> I **used to play** tennis. Now I play golf.
> Liz **used to have** long hair. (Now it's short.)
> They **used to live** in the same street as us.

## How to make it
> subject + **used to** + infinitive

The form is the same for all persons.
> When I was a child, I **used to like** chocolate.
> Ann **used to have** a piano.

## Negative and questions
We use **did** and the form changes to **use to**.
> I **didn't use to like** tomatoes.
> **Did** you **use to live** here?
> Where **did** you **use to live**?

## Only for the past
There is no present form *use to*. For the present use the present simple.
- ~~I use to play golf.~~ → I **play** golf these days.
- ~~We use to get up early.~~ → We **usually get up** early.

## Compare
- **used to work** = he worked there for some time before, but not now: He **used to work** in a factory. Now he works in a supermarket.
- **worked** = one fact in the past: He **worked** there in 2010.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I didn't used to like it.~~ → I didn't **use** to like it.
- ~~Did you used to play?~~ → Did you **use** to play?
- ~~I used to going there.~~ → I used to **go** there.
structure:
## Формы
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I used to smoke. | I didn't use to smoke. | Did you use to smoke? |
| She used to be shy. | She didn't use to be shy. | Did she use to be shy? |
| They used to live here. | They didn't use to live here. | Did they use to live here? |

## Краткие ответы
- Did you use to play? — Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**.

## Формула
> **used to** + глагол (инфинитив) — утверждение
> **didn't use to** + глагол — отрицание
> **Did** + подлежащее + **use to** + глагол ... ? — вопрос

## Что ещё запомнить
- used to — **только прошлое**, для настоящего его нет
- после **did / didn't** пишем **use to** (без -d)
- используем с глаголами состояния: have, be, like, live
- обычно сравниваем «раньше — теперь»: **used to ... but now ...**

exercises.title: Раньше и теперь
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения с **used to** и глаголом в скобках.
exercises.example: Now Liz has short hair. (be long) → It used to be long.

items.text: Now I live in a city. I {{used to live}} in the country.
Tom is a teacher now. He {{used to be}} a taxi driver.
We have a car now. We {{used to go}} everywhere by bus.
She works in an office now. She {{used to work}} in a shop.
Now I drink tea. I {{used to drink}} a lot of coffee.
He is thin now. He {{used to be}} fat.

exercises.title: Отрицания и вопросы
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения: **didn't use to** или **did ... use to**.

items.text: I {{didn't use to|did not use to}} like fish, but now I love it.
She {{didn't use to|did not use to}} wear glasses.
We {{didn't use to|did not use to}} have a TV.

items.q: When I was a child, I ___ chocolate.

items.why: Раньше играла, теперь нет → **used to play**.

items.q: We usually ___ up early these days.

options: I used to live in a village.
I use to live in a village.
I used to living in a village.
She didn't used to like coffee.
She didn't use to like coffee.
She not used to like coffee.
Where did you use to live?
Where do you use to live?
We use to get up early.
We used to usually get up early.
My grandfather used to have a dog.
My grandfather used to has a dog.
My grandfather use to have a dog.

exercises.title: Used to или past simple?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **used to** или past simple глагола в скобках.

items.text: When I was young, I {{used to climb}} trees every weekend.
My grandma {{used to tell|used to read}} us stories every night.
He {{used to be}} very shy, but now he is very open.

answers: I used to play football every Saturday.
Dave used to work in a factory.
We didn't use to have a TV.
We did not use to have a TV.
Did you use to live in a village?
She used to have long hair.
They didn't use to like sports.
They did not use to like sports.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Расскажите о том, что вы раньше делали. Используйте **used to**.

items.prompt: Что вы любили делать в детстве?
items.sample: I used to play outside with my friends every day.

items.prompt: Что вы раньше не любили, а теперь любите?
items.sample: I didn't use to like vegetables, but now I love them.
I used to live in a small village.

items.prompt: Что у вас раньше было, а теперь нет?
items.sample: I used to have a bike, but I sold it.

items.prompt: Спросите друга, чем он занимался раньше.
items.sample: Did you use to play any sports when you were a child?
